title: Hypothetical scenario option: harbor shuttle link, Tradepoint Atlantic to Hawkins Point
mechanism: Adds a scenario-only shuttle connection between the Tradepoint Atlantic road network on the north bank and the Fort Armistead road network at Hawkins Point on the south bank, roughly where the Key Bridge used to cross. It is modeled as a fixed boarding wait plus a straight-line crossing at constant speed, in both directions. Disabled in the baseline; enabling it lets cross-harbor trips skip the long drive around the harbor. It carries people and cars only: vehicles carrying hazardous materials cannot use it.

sites: Tradepoint Atlantic, Tradepoint Avenue at Plate Mill Road
Dock Road at Fort Armistead Road, Hawkins Point

notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: new road connector, Broening Highway to Tradepoint Atlantic
mechanism: Adds a scenario-only local road connection between the southern end of Broening Highway and Tradepoint Avenue at Tradepoint Atlantic, both on the north bank, driven at a constant local-road speed in both directions. Disabled in the baseline. It shortens trips between the Dundalk port area and the Sparrows Point peninsula but does not cross the river.

sites: Tradepoint Avenue at Plate Mill Road

notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: new road connector, Dundalk Avenue to Tradepoint Atlantic
mechanism: Adds a scenario-only local road connection between Dundalk Avenue and Tradepoint Avenue at Tradepoint Atlantic, both on the north bank, driven at a constant local-road speed in both directions. Disabled in the baseline. It gives the Dundalk neighborhood a more direct route onto the Sparrows Point peninsula but does not cross the river.

sites: Dundalk Avenue north of Broening Highway
Tradepoint Avenue at Plate Mill Road

notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: flow management on the Baltimore Beltway
mechanism: Applies faster clearance of incidents and smoother merging along the whole Baltimore Beltway corridor, including the western arc that becomes the detour when the Key Bridge is gone. Every road segment of the corridor gets a modest speed gain. It only helps trips that use the Beltway.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: tunnel flow management, Harbor Tunnel
mechanism: Applies faster incident clearance and traffic metering to the tunnel bores of the Harbor Tunnel only, not to its approaches. Every tunnel segment gets a modest speed gain. It helps trips that cross the harbor by tunnel.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: approach flow management, Harbor Tunnel corridor
mechanism: Applies faster incident clearance and ramp metering along the highway that feeds the Harbor Tunnel, outside the tunnel bores themselves. Every approach segment gets a modest speed gain. It helps trips that reach the tunnel from either side.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: tunnel flow management, Fort McHenry Tunnel
mechanism: Applies faster incident clearance and traffic metering to the tunnel bores of the Fort McHenry Tunnel only. Every tunnel segment gets a modest speed gain. It helps trips that cross the harbor by that tunnel.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: flow management on the north-south interstate corridor
mechanism: Applies faster incident clearance and smoother merging along the interstate that runs through the Fort McHenry Tunnel approaches, outside the tunnel bores. Every road segment of the corridor gets a modest speed gain. It helps long north-south trips more than harbor-crossing trips.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: signal retiming on Broening Highway
mechanism: Retimes signals along Broening Highway, the surface route between the Dundalk port area and the tunnels. Every road segment of the corridor gets a moderate speed gain. It helps freight and commuter trips that use that surface route.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: signal retiming on Hanover Street
mechanism: Retimes signals along Hanover Street, the surface route that links South Baltimore with the southern neighborhoods. Every road segment of the corridor gets a moderate speed gain. It is west of the harbor crossings and helps trips that use that street.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: flow management on the downtown spur interstate
mechanism: Applies faster incident clearance and smoother merging along the short interstate spur into downtown from the south. Every road segment of the corridor gets a modest speed gain. It is far from the Key Bridge site and is included as a control option.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: staging site at Tradepoint Atlantic
mechanism: Places a scenario-only staging location for response units at Tradepoint Avenue on the Sparrows Point peninsula. The EMS lens treats it as one more station. It matters for the industrial peninsula, where population is sparse.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: staging site at the southern end of Broening Highway
mechanism: Places a scenario-only staging location for response units at the southern end of Broening Highway near the Dundalk port area. The EMS lens treats it as one more station.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: staging site at Curtis Bay
mechanism: Places a scenario-only staging location for response units on Pennington Avenue in Curtis Bay on the south bank. The EMS lens treats it as one more station.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.

title: Hypothetical scenario option: scheduled escorted window for hazardous-materials vehicles in the Harbor Tunnel
mechanism: Allows vehicles that carry hazardous materials to use the Harbor Tunnel during a scheduled, escorted window, at the price of a fixed extra delay for each passage through the tunnel. It changes nothing for cars. It only shortens freight trips that would otherwise have to take the long way around the harbor. This is a scenario-only lever; whether such a window is allowed is a matter for the responsible agencies.
notes: Hypothetical scenario option; not proposed, studied or endorsed by any agency.
